name: Linear
label: Linear GraphQL API
description: Linear GraphQL at https://api.linear.app/graphql. POST query + variables. issue_create/update take title, teamId, description, assigneeId, priority (nested under variables.input). Docs: https://developers.linear.app/docs/graphql/working-with-the-graphql-api. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Linear official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"issue_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'issue_create', 'issue_get', 'issue_list', 'issue_update', 'issue_delete', 'issue_add_link', 'comment_add', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'issue_create'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: GraphQL query or mutation document (required). issue_create example: mutation($input: IssueCreateInput!){ issueCreate(input:$input){ success issue{ id identifier title url } } }.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: GraphQL variables object escape hatch. Purpose fields nest into variables.input (or variables.id for issueId).

schema.label: title
schema.description: Issue title. Wired to variables.input.title on issue_create / issue_update. Example: Checkout 500.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Markdown description. Wired to variables.input.description on issue_create / issue_update.

schema.label: teamId
schema.description: Linear team UUID. Wired to variables.input.teamId. Required by IssueCreateInput. Example: a UUID.

schema.label: assigneeId
schema.description: Assignee user UUID. Wired to variables.input.assigneeId.

schema.label: stateId
schema.description: Workflow state UUID. Wired to variables.input.stateId.

schema.label: priority
schema.description: Priority 0–4 (0 none … 1 urgent). Wired to variables.input.priority.

schema.label: issueId
schema.description: Issue id for get/update/delete/comment/link. Wired to variables.id. Example: ENG-123 id UUID.

schema.label: parentId
schema.description: Parent issue id. Wired to variables.input.parentId on issue_create / issue_update.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Attachment URL for issue_add_link. Wired to variables.input.url.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Comment markdown for comment_add. Wired to variables.input.body.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: issue_create, issue_get, issue_list, issue_update, issue_delete, issue_add_link, comment_add, listen. Default: issue_create. Example: issue_create.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_key). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
